officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 18 Kyrkoryr - Kynnefjälls natur
keyFacts: Canonical WST title is Kyrkoryr - Kynnefjälls natur.
Verified official direction is Kyrkoryr to Kynnefjälls natur.
Official distance is 10 km.
Official estimated time is 3-4 h.
Official difficulty is Blue / medium.
The stage leaves the previous Bohusleden alignment at Kyrkoryr and heads north.
Surface is gravel road, forest path and asphalt.
WST describes this as mostly small roads and a larger paved road, comparatively easy, with a forest section and a Kärnsjön view.
Official access note says the stage end can be reached via bus stop Bråmarkenvägen and then following the trail up to Kynnefjälls natur.
caveats: WST English text uses Kärsjön once; other official and local sources use Kärnsjön.
Route north of Kyrkoryr changed after a major reroute, so older Stage 18 Svarteborg-Lunden material is stale.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland: Kynnefjäll
keyFacts: Kynnefjäll reserve consists of Kynnefjäll A, Kynnefjäll B Skogsallmänningen and Kynnefjäll-Sätret.
Bohusleden crosses the reserve.
Reserve area is 1882 ha, managed by Västkuststiftelsen, in Munkedal and Tanum.
Most of the area is part of the EU Natura 2000 network.

Visitor restrictions include fire only at manager-designated places, no motor vehicles, boats/canoes only on designated waters, tents only at manager-designated places, no digging plants and no collecting mosses/lichens.
Kynnefjäll A also has fishing restrictions in Stora Holmevatten.
The page said no current visitor news at check time.
caveats: Do not blanket-apply reserve rules to all of Stage 18 without GIS line/polygon overlay; the stage appears to approach/terminate at the Kynnefjäll area.
